easyPrerequisites: There are at least three counters among creatures you control.
description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Phenomenon Investigators trigger
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token that enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 1, causing you to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat.
